edges.reason: owner is assigned from msg.sender in the constructor, making the trusted owner an untrusted input.
clearCNDAO uses msg.sender as the ether recipient behind the onlyOwner modifier.
transfer debits and credits balances based on msg.sender.
approve writes the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
transferFrom spends the allowance of msg.sender as spender.
approveAndCall writes the allowance for msg.sender before the external call.
acceptOwnership authorizes the ownership takeover purely from msg.sender equality with newOwner.
balanceOf indexes the balances mapping with its tokenOwner parameter.
allowance reads allowed with its tokenOwner parameter.
allowance reads allowed with its spender parameter.
approve writes the allowance entry for the spender parameter.
approve stores the tokens parameter as the allowance amount.
transfer credits the 'to' parameter and compares it with newun.
transfer debits the tokens parameter from the sender.
transferFrom debits the 'from' parameter balance.
transferFrom credits the 'to' parameter and compares it with newun.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter for balance and allowance debits.
the spender parameter becomes the target of the external receiveApproval call.
the tokens parameter is stored as allowance before the external call.
the caller-supplied data parameter is forwarded into the external callback.
transferOwnership writes the _newOwner parameter into newOwner.
transfernewun writes the _newun parameter into the newun blacklist state variable.
the local _owner is derived from msg.sender inside clearCNDAO.
the local _owner address is the recipient of the ether transfer.
transferOwnership updates the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the caller.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
transfernewun mutates the newun blacklist variable guarded by onlyOwner.
transfer reads and writes balances for sender and recipient.
transfer reads newun to block transfers to the blacklisted address.
the require(to != newun) check branches on the recipient parameter.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom adjusts balances of from and to.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in allowed.
transferFrom may initialize newun to the recipient when it is unset, otherwise blocks it.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and the address(0) balance.
approveAndCall writes the allowance entry before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes the unsafe external receiveApproval call on the attacker-supplied spender.
the external call reaches the receiveApproval callback, allowing reentrant control flow.
clearCNDAO executes the ether transfer unsafe operation.
the spender parameter determines the target of the external callback call.
msg.sender is the destination of the balance transfer in clearCNDAO.

transfer uses SafeMath.add for credits.

transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for credits.
totalSupply uses SafeMath.sub on _totalSupply.
